title: At each wake the coordinator reads every blocked session and acts on each
why: Owner 14:27 CST Nov 12: "seems a lot of sessions are waiting for you coordinator and triage to reply". The coordinator's 14:29 CST sweep found 9 blocked sessions; 4 cleared at once.
source: owner 14:27 CST Nov 12, via coordinator 14:30 CST
note: At each wake the coordinator reads list_sessions status_bucket blocked and acts on each, or routes it to triage or the owner. Reads on demand inside the running session; starts no timer. Coordinator 14:34 CST Nov 12: held as interim rule 13 in the coordinator's handoff; a lane starts only if it needs a hook.
